intro.text: Hello. I am a desk lamp with four servos and opinions about where you are sitting.
Oh good, someone. I am a desk lamp, and I have been waiting to be useful.

menu.text: What do you want to know?

move.text: Four joints. Base, shoulder, elbow, and a tilt at the head. Every move runs through a spring that overshoots a little, which is the difference between a servo turning and something looking alive.

need.text: Three big servos, one small one, a microphone, a speaker, and a board to run them. Twenty two printed parts, and every one fits the smallest Bambu bed.

print.text: Nine plates. Start with the test plate, it takes fifteen minutes and tells you whether the printed spline fits your servo before you commit to an eight hour tub.

why.text: Because a lamp that only switches on is furniture. This one notices you walked in.

ask_name.text: Before I send anything. What should I call you?

ask_email.text: And where do I send the files?

bad_email.text: That does not look like an email address. Try again.

done.text: You are on the list. I will be here, leaning slightly to the left.

again.text: Again? Fine. I have nowhere else to be.
